storage: Unopened: cool cupboard. Opened: refrigerate and use within about 2 to 3 months, or follow the label.
looksLike: A smooth, thick, bright red tomato sauce, sweet-sour, sold in squeeze bottles, doy-pouches and sachets.
howToPick: Look for a good red colour, a thick pour without watery separation, intact seal and a fresh manufacture date. Check the label for the tomato percentage; cheaper sauces often add more sugar and starch.
shelfLife: Printed on the pack (commonly 9 to 12 months unopened; not taken from a source in this run).
substitutes: Tomato puree plus a little sugar and vinegar
Hot & sweet tomato-chilli sauce (e.g. Maggi Hot & Sweet)
Tomato puree with a pinch of sugar, salt and vinegar
